blocks.x: Beloved by hikers, campers, and outdoor adventurers—myself included—REI has an excellent line of gear that spans everything from shoes and clothing to blankets to mountain bikes. Whether you’re planning your first national park trip or organizing a multi-day backpacking excursion, REI has all you’ll need to get started. Even better, there are plenty of great deals to stock up on gear without breaking the bank.

Originally created in 1938, the brand’s founders had a dream of sharing their love of the outdoors with the world around them, and in almost a century, REI hasn’t strayed from that ethos. REI truly embraces its identity as an adventure brand, encouraging people to get outdoors and explore nature. Whether you’re a new customer or a seasoned regular, there are plenty of ways to save on REI gear and clothing as long as you know where to look. Read on to discover some of the best coupon codes and savings at REI right now. Looking for more outdoor adventuring gear? Take a peek at our Snow Peak discount codes and Mountain Hardwear coupons.
Get an REI volume discount of up to 15% without a coupon this fall

Buy more to save more with REI’s volume discounts this fall, which let you save up to 15% when you bundle multiple products—especially helpful when you’re purchasing big-ticket items like a tent, bicycle, or kayak. A few of the products you can save big on are socks (take up to 10% off when you buy three or more full-priced pairs), cycle accessories (take up to 15% off bike accessories, clothing, and shoes when you purchase any full-price Co-op Cycles bike that same day), REI Co-op brand camping gear (save 10% on bundles of full price tents, sleeping bags, and sleeping pads, as well as 10% on backpacking food and snacks when you meet the minimum purchase requirement of 8 and 10 respectively), and finally 15% off full-price paddles when you purchase a kayak, canoe, or stand-up paddleboard.
For more ways to save with REI, head straight to their discount page for the most up-to-date information on active REI coupons.
Get a 15% off REI promo code with email newsletter sign-up

One of the easiest ways to score a discount is by signing up for REI’s email newsletter. Upon sign-up, you’ll score 15% off one full-priced item, which you can redeem on anything eligible on the site, from backpacks to hiking boots. After signing up, you’ll receive a unique coupon code sent directly to your email; keep in mind you have to use it within 30 days of receipt, or you’ll forfeit your discount. A newsletter subscription means more than just a one-time discount—once you sign up, you’ll be one of the first people to receive updates on all the latest gear arrivals, any upcoming sales, and exclusive coupons in the future, all delivered directly to your inbox.
Shop REI sale deals for up to 79% off hiking boots and gear without a coupon

For the greatest bang for your buck, head to REI’s deals section, which features all of last season’s gear for up to 79% off. Looking for a rain jacket or parka to protect you from the elements? Score savings of up to $200. In need of some hiking boots for your next excursion? They’ve got you covered with up to 70% off your desired footwear, including savings on favorites like 25% off women’s Merrell Moab 3 hiking shoes and 50% off Merrell men’s Moab 2 Decon SE hiking shoes. You can also expect savings on backpacks (up to 30% off top brands like Osprey, The North Face, Patagonia, and more), as well as socks (10% off bundle deals when you buy three or more full-priced socks).
REI bikes and camping essentials are now up to 50% off without a coupon

Thinking of starting another hobby? There’s never been a better time to exercise your free will (and just plain exercise) by scooping up a new bike or tent to start your next outdoor adventure. Customers can expect savings of up to 30% off bikes and a whopping 50% off camping gear on REI’s deals page. Score big on electric and mountain bikes, like 20% off the Co-op Cycles CTY 1.1 bike, so you’ll be able to traverse any terrain in style.

For those interested in dipping their toe into the camping lifestyle, expect savings on plenty of the gear you’ll need to get started, including tents, sleeping bags, and camping essentials, like a whopping 50% off the REI Co-op Campwell 6 tent. Head out on your next big trip through Yellowstone National Park or Glacier in style, and without the worry that you’ll be underprepared once you arrive. From camping chairs to keep you comfortable around the firepit to video cameras that always capture that perfect shot for your Instagram (or your memories), there are plenty of ways to save on all your necessities—and a few extras just in case.
Save up to 66% off on outdoor brands you love with the REI Outlet

No longer do you need to head to a store in person and battle it out for the last jacket on the rack: REI’s online outlet has tons of great gear to save on, all shoppable from the comfort of your own home. From shoes and socks to helmets, boots, and bags, expect huge savings on something for everyone. One of my favorites includes 27% off Smartwool Active Fleece Wind pants. There’s also plenty of other deals on travel gear worth calling out, like 30% off the CamelBak All Around travel tumbler and 41% off the Osprey Arcane small crossbody bag. On REI’s outlet page, shop top brands like Arc’teryx, Hoka, Keen, Osprey, Patagonia, Salomon, and Columbia, all in one spot.
Save 10% every year with a lifetime REI membership—and score a $30 gift card

For something a bit more consistent, sign up for an REI lifetime membership to score an estimated 10% off every year on all eligible purchases. Memberships are a one-time payment of $30, and last the rest of your life, so you’ll be able to score benefits for years to come. To get your rewards, simply shop as you usually would, and earn back an estimated 10% Co-op Member Reward annually on eligible full-price co-op purchases. Your reward will automatically be uploaded to your account in the following month.

Members get more benefits, like free standard shipping on every order (5–7 business days)—a convenience that non-members can only reap the reward of when they hit the $60 minimum spend. Members also save 20% off on bike and snow shop services, have extended return windows of up to a year rather than the usual 90 days, get free ski and board wax and a flat tire tube with repair, and up to 33% off gear rentals. All of these benefits more than make up for the $30 fee.

As an added bonus, those who sign up by November 12, 2026, will also receive a $30 gift card, which they can use on whatever they please for 30 days after they sign up. To be eligible to receive this gift card, all you have to do is make a $50 purchase at REI and buy your membership in the same order. This means your $30 one-time membership fee is basically free once you take advantage of the gift card.
Trade in used gear through Re/Supply, get REI gift cards

Give your gear and clothing a second life when you trade in gently used products to REI’s Re/Supply platform—and receive a gift card for eligible items. Simply fill out the trade-in form to get an estimate on your product’s eligibility and credit value. Then drop your products off at your nearest REI store. Once your trade-in is complete and your product has been evaluated, you’ll receive an email with an REI e-gift card that you’ll be able to use to purchase more of your favorite gear.

Your used products will head to REI’s Re/Supply shop. Not only is this a great way to keep textiles and other items out of landfills, but you’ll get money back to spend on something else. These gently used secondhand products are shoppable as well, and at great discounts, so if you’re open to taking home a pre-loved item rather than springing for a new piece, expect to find some excellent savings. The brand is closing its online version of the shop, but customers can still purchase gently used items in its brick-and-mortar stores.
Earn 15% in rewards and a $100 gift card with an REI credit card

One final way to keep to your budget and still get some great deals is by signing up for the REI credit card. Customers who open an REI Co-op Mastercard get a total of 15% in REI rewards (5% card rewards on all REI purchases and 10% Co-op member rewards). Cardholders also earn 1.5% in rewards on all other purchases when not shopping at REI. As a bonus, there is no annual fee, and the rewards no longer expire.

REI credit cards are only available to members, so you’ll have to complete the one-time sign-up and $30 membership fee, but once you do so, you’ll be able to sign in online and validate your Co-op membership to join and start racking up rewards. All rewards are ready to be redeemed online and in stores at REI as soon as they pop up in your account. As a bonus, customers can expect a $100 REI gift card after their very first purchase outside of REI, but use it quickly, as the gift card expires 60 days after your account is opened.
How to fix an REI coupon that’s not working

If your REI coupon isn’t working, there are a few things you can do before deeming it a lost cause. First, check to ensure that you’ve typed in the coupon code correctly. Capital letters, accidental spaces, and numbers that look like letters can sometimes be the culprit. If everything looks in order, take a glance at the coupon code’s terms and conditions. Has the code already expired? Perhaps you haven’t reached the minimum spend threshold or are trying to use it on a product that is excluded from the promotion. If that doesn’t seem to be the issue, consider restarting your browser, switching to a different device, or clearing your cookies and cache to rule out any personal hardware or software issues. If all else fails, reach out to REI’s help center for more personalized help.
